messages:
olivia-sec: FYI alert from our integrity checks: several DB snapshot exports to s3 during the midnight migration show no `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header. tagging to triage. :warning:
kms-bot: Alert: snapshot-export-no-sse (rule: snapshot-sse-required). Examples: s3://snap-exports/prod/db-snap-2026-06-01.sql.gz
mark-sre: rough count? is this all snapshots or just one export job?
olivia-sec: initial scan found 18 objects across two export jobs (00:06 and 00:12). I pulled head-object for one: 
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket snap-exports --key prod/db-snap-2026-06-01.sql.gz
{
  "ContentLength": 98734567,
  "ContentType": "application/gzip",
  "ServerSideEncryption": null,
  "Metadata": {}
}
```
natalie-ops: migration note: we rotated the export-service role bindings as part of RBAC cleanup at 2026-06-01T00:00Z. the script swapped to a narrower role and removed a legacy inline policy. suspect it removed kms:Encrypt temporarily. i have the change diff.
paul-platform: i see the deploy logs: `export-role-migrate v3.1` did `detach inline-policy legacy-export-writes` then `attach policy export-writes-min`. attach returned success, but the policy lacks kms:Encrypt.
olivia-sec: that matches. if the uploader lost kms:Encrypt, requests still succeeded to S3 but without SSE-KMS header. need containment: freeze deletions on the export prefix and tag objects as evidence.
mark-sre: remediation options: (A) re-copy objects to add SSE-KMS using the canonical CMK, (B) if export is immutable and re-copy not allowed, create a temporary grant and rotate CMK + notify customers. prefer re-copy.
paul-platform: i'll own the re-copy. plan: copy to s3://snap-exports-encrypted/ with `--sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id <arn>` then verify checksum. doing a dry-run script now.
natalie-ops: follow-ups: update migration script to check policy contents before detaching, or detach only after new policy attached. add a CI gate that lints policies for required actions `s3:PutObject` and `kms:Encrypt` for export flows.
olivia-sec: add CloudTrail anomaly alert: PutObject without SSE-KMS into critical buckets. Also add a short postmortem template and tag INC-2026-06-01-030. do not auto-notify customers until we map tenants.
mark-sre: quick commands for whoever automates detection: 
```
# find objects without SSE
aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket snap-exports --prefix prod/ --query 'Contents[].Key' | jq -r '.[]' | while read k; do aws s3api head-object --bucket snap-exports --key "$k" | jq -r '"$k " + (.ServerSideEncryption // "NONE")'; done
```
kms-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-06-01-030  assigned paul-platform. Severity: P2.
paul-platform: started copy job at 2026-06-01T02:10Z for the 18 objects. ETA ~3h. will update when checksum-verified.
olivia-sec: thanks. i'll start mapping objects -> tenant ids and prep legal notification draft in case we need to escalate.
